cases.text: Namaste Anjali Verma, 3 Nov Tuesday ko Morning shift 07:00-15:00 ke liye replacement chahiye. Aap standby par hain aur isse sirf 1 cell change hoga, rank 1 par hone ki wajah se aapko pucha hai. Kripya Accept ya Decline tap karein.
